english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical or figurative route, road, or direction.
This is the all-purpose noun for a physical road and, in expressions such as the road to success, a life or career path.
This is the all-purpose choice for a path, route, figurative way, or way of proceeding when no narrower context is needed.
This is the all-purpose choice for a path or road people travel on, especially when no special transport or highway distinction is intended.
Use this when the street is being viewed more broadly as a road or route, including in street names.
